title: ジャパンCの後に・得たもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon is defeated by Tokai Teio at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, as she is enveloped by the cheers of the crowd, she's happy to find that she was able to inspire others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio praises her, saying that Mihono Bourbon ran so well against her that she still feels frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them promise to have a rematch someday.
